brief:
Kamal Aljafari has created a film using suppressed archive material depicting destroyed houses, terrorised children, and dead bodies, according to The Guardian. The work overlays poems by Palestinian authors in Arabic onto the footage, adding layers of meaning to the raw documentation.

The film's title, "Fidai," refers to someone willing to sacrifice themselves for the greater good in Arabic. By combining visual records with literary voice, Aljafari transforms historical material into artistic works that restore humanity to the images.

title: Palestinian filmmaker transforms archive footage into artistic collage
